dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent closed-loop 'O' shapes in the upper-right quadrant exhibit jagged, high-contrast white-to-dark-grey perimeters. A large 'C' shaped structure mid-lateral shows a feathered gradient transition from a bright exterior border to a medium-grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, solid white circular blobs scattered primarily in the lower-lateral region. High concentration of core white pixels within these isolated clusters, lacking the internal grey-scaling seen in the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of four prominent annuli in the dorsal-lateral region form an asymmetrical quadrilateral with an obtuse angle at the most posterior point. Spatial distances between centroids are approximately 1.5x the average diameter of the structures.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-intensity linear white mark, approximately three times longer than adjacent spots, is located on the upper dorsal ridge near the midpoint.
